The title and the author are not stored in the target.
3 notes change pitch, waveform or pulse width while sounding (wavetable, vibrato, arpeggio, glide, pulse sweep); the program holds one value of each per note.
13 changes of the filter or volume registers between note starts are not written; the values are updated at note starts only.

Records are timed with TI (60 Hz, 16.7 ms steps) and the interpreter writes one register about every 10 ms: predicted note start error 5 ms mean, 7 ms maximum; the phase of TI adds up to 17 ms, and gate-offs are less exact than note starts. 2 gate-offs shortly before the next note of a voice are written together with that note.
